_comment: Issue #97: FIXTURE-FIRST start for invrisil_mothbear_loop -- the accept-fight-turnin loop for bounty_mothbear_cull (single-kill, NIGHT-gated). Guild desk-approach cell (8,3) facing up (accept happens here, same as every other bounty canonical) -- the fixture does NOT claim to stand on invrisil_boulevard, so test_fixture_coherence.gd's MAP_REQUIRES chain for that map never applies; the script's own `teleport` step (a debug action that bypasses door gates entirely, the dungeon_peek/pallass_peek precedent) reaches the boulevard directly. `actions_since_sleep:500` makes phase=night from frame 1 (goblin_night_patrol_start/boulevard_night_footpads_start's own convention -- phase is a pure function of this counter, independent of current_map), so no in-script time-advance is needed before the ambush can spring. Gear/classes = sim_combat_batch.gd's own `t3_warrior10` build (the SAME build boulevard_mothbears_t3_solo is measured against). times_slept 22 (== board_last_seen_times_slept) puts the pool window at [22,23,24] = [bounty_mothbear_cull, bounty_kingslayer_cull, bounty_forge_golem_cull] -- mothbear_cull visible as the picker's 1st option. rng_state derived from seed=2 (empirically re-derived -- seed=1 lost the fight in the real game flow): verified seed=2's first rng.randi() draw resolves the boulevard_mothbears fight as a win (single-kill, no second draw needed).
